classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding sides in differently oriented and joined congruent triangles.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumerals in these diagrams that include congruent triangles.

spec.description: Paired downward- and upward-pointing triangles with corresponding single and double side ticks and filled angle dots.
spec.mathematics: The unticked sides correspond; the single-ticked sides correspond. The marked vertices correspond.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x, y, 5.2 and 7.3 are visible; answers are withheld.

answer.worked: Corresponding sides of congruent triangles are equal. The unticked sides correspond, so $x=7.3$. The single-ticked sides correspond, so $y=5.2$.

spec.description: Bow-tie triangles share an intersection. Both outer sides have double upward parallel arrows. The descending diagonal has double equal-length ticks on each half.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding outer sides are 11 and y; corresponding ascending-diagonal segments are x and 12.
spec.answerVisibility: The givens 11 and 12 and unknowns x and y are visible.

answer.worked: The crossing diagonals give equal vertically opposite angles, and the parallel outer sides give equal corresponding triangle angles. The marked diagonal segments correspond. Hence the congruent triangles have equal corresponding sides: $x=12$ and $y=11$.

spec.description: Inverted isosceles triangle with double ticks on its slopes, a red dashed internal segment, and separate full-width and right-half dimension arrows.
spec.mathematics: Equal sloping sides are 2.4 and b. The full top side a consists of two corresponding halves, one labelled 1.3.
spec.answerVisibility: Only a, b, 2.4 and 1.3 are visible.

answer.worked:
The two congruent triangles have equal corresponding top segments.
$$\begin{align*}a&=1.3+1.3\\a&=2.6\end{align*}$$
The marked sloping sides are equal, so $b=2.4$.

spec.description: Parallelogram split by a red dashed diagonal from upper left to lower right. Horizontal sides carry single rightward parallel arrows; sloping sides carry double upward-right arrows.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding horizontal sides are 16 and x; corresponding sloping sides are 9 and y.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 16, 9, x and y are visible.

answer.worked: The diagonal separates the parallelogram into congruent triangles. Corresponding sides are equal, so $x=16$ and $y=9$.
